title: Health Assessments
desc: 45–49 year, 75+ year, and Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander health assessments fully covered by Medicare.
detail: Comprehensive health assessments are available for eligible patients. These include 45–49 year wellbeing checks, annual 75+ health assessments, and targeted Indigenous health checks — all bulk billed.
fullDesc: Medicare funds a range of comprehensive health assessments for eligible patients. The 45–49 Year Health Assessment is a one-off check to identify risk factors for chronic disease. The 75+ Year Assessment is available annually to support healthy ageing. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health checks are available from age 0 and focus on culturally appropriate, preventive care. All eligible assessments are bulk billed.
